name: Yangmingshan Visitor Center
location: No. 1‑20, Zhuzihu Road, Beitou District, Taipei City, 11292, Taiwan
description: The main visitor center of Yangmingshan National Park, providing exhibits about the park’s ecology, geology, and human history, plus information services and guided tours.

name: Yangmingshuwu
location: No. 12, Zhongxing Road, Beitou District, Taipei City, 11292, Taiwan
description: Former summer residence of Chiang Kai-shek, now a visitor service station with historical exhibits, guided tours, and a model of the Zhongxing Guesthouse.

name: Yangming Park
location: Yangmingshan National Park, Shilin/Beitou Districts, Taipei City, Taiwan
description: A scenic park in Yangmingshan National Park featuring flower gardens, walking paths, and views of the city — a popular place for relaxing and hiking.

name: Datun Recreation Area
location: Yangmingshan National Park, Beitou District, Taipei City, Taiwan
description: A volcanic recreation area in Yangmingshan with hiking trails, volcanic landforms, and rich ecological scenery, part of the Datun volcanic group.

name: Taipei Astronomical Museum
location: No. 363, Jihe Road, Shilin District, Taipei City, Taiwan
description: A museum dedicated to astronomy, featuring exhibition areas on ancient astronomy, space technology, the solar system, a dome theater, and observatories.

name: Taipei Water Park
location: No. 1, Siyuan Street, Zhongzheng District, Taipei City, Taiwan
description: An environmental education park and museum in the former Gongguan waterworks site. It includes the Museum of Drinking Water and facilities for ecological learning and recreation.

name: National Chiang Kai‑shek Memorial Hall
location: No. 21, Zhongshan South Road, Zhongzheng District, Taipei City, Taiwan
description: A national monument built in memory of Chiang Kai-shek, featuring a large plaza, gardens, a ceremonial changing of the guard, and exhibition halls.

name: Taipei 101
location: No. 7, Section 5, Xinyi Road, Xinyi District, Taipei City, Taiwan
description: One of the world’s tallest skyscrapers, famous for its observation decks, shopping mall, and architectural design symbolizing bamboo stalks.

name: Beitou Hot Spring Museum
location: No. 2, Zhongshan Road, Beitou District, Taipei City, Taiwan
description: Housed in a historic Japanese-era bathhouse, this museum showcases the history of hot springs in Beitou, traditional bathing culture, and the area’s geology.

name: National Taiwan Museum
location: No. 2, Section 1, Zhongzheng South Road, Zhongzheng District, Taipei City, Taiwan
description: Taiwan’s oldest museum, presenting natural history, cultural relics, and anthropology. Located near the 228 Peace Memorial Park.
